articles.title: Critical Apache Airflow Flaw CVE-2026-68982 Enables Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
articles.summary:
A critical missing-authentication flaw in Apache Airflow lets attackers run code on Celery workers without any Airflow credentials. Tracked as CVE-2026-68982, the bug is classified as CWE-306 and affects Airflow versions before 3.4.0 that use CeleryExecutor. Anyone who can write to the Celery broker can make a worker run any Python function it can import, […]

articles.title: Russian-Linked Turla Hackers Abuse Microsoft Exchange Infrastructure to Target Sensitive Communications
articles.summary:
Russian-linked espionage group Turla has deployed a previously undocumented .NET malware toolkit that turns compromised Microsoft Exchange servers into surveillance platforms and command infrastructure. Named Cereal, the modular toolset intercepts selected emails while allowing legitimate messages to continue through the transport pipeline, concealing intelligence collection inside routine government communications.
